POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for electronic systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.
   C. Skip safety briefings for electronic systems.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after electronic systems.
